items: No easing after a few days

caption:
Big game on Saturday, walking down stairs sideways on Monday?

That muscle soreness is common after unusual effort and usually settles within a few days. Research suggests massage can ease how sore you feel and help you relax after hard exercise. A lighter session a day or two later often feels good, with deeper work saved until the soreness eases.

Massage complements the basics rather than replacing them: sleep, a meal with protein, fluids and easy movement the next day. A bit of midweek training helps too.

Sharp pain, swelling, bruising or trouble taking weight is worth a physio assessment instead. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
